name: ref_cave_water_camera_v2

arguments.prompt:
STYLE BIBLE (verbatim):
STYLE: this is a CONCEPT FRAME of one biome of the same game as Image 1, not a game asset. Match Image 1 exactly in rendering: dark-fantasy dungeon pixel art, every pixel a hard square of one flat colour on one even grid, the same pixel size, the same top-down 3/4 dungeon-crawler camera (floors seen from above, walls and props show their front faces), the same scale (the hero is about 55 pixels tall in a 1024-pixel-tall image), the same chunky stone-block walls with dark mortar, a 1-pixel dark outline around characters and props.
Light: lit exactly like Image 1 — warm or coloured pools of light around torches, candles and braziers, flames with white-hot cores, glowing emissive sources, strong falloff into deep shadow; the solid rock between rooms is pure black void; high contrast, low-key.
Palette: low-key and muted like Image 1 — charcoal and slate stone, rust and leather browns, deep reds, bone; saturated colour only in light sources and the biome accent.
Layout: one continuous play area seen from the game camera — 3 to 4 rooms joined by corridors and doorways, the rooms cut out of black rock, filling the whole frame edge to edge; the hero (red cape, steel breastplate, sword) stands in the middle room fighting 2-3 monsters. Everything walkable must stay reachable: any river, pit or deep pool is crossed by a bridge, a stone path or stepping stones.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no HUD, no panels, no minimap, no health bars, no logos, no watermark.

INPUT IMAGES:
Image 1: style reference: match style, palette, rendering and light; do not copy composition.
Image 2: selected appearance: natural rock, calm water, palette and mood only; flatten its relief.
Image 3: edit target: correct the three specified failures; preserve palette and central actors.

ASSET:
Correct Image 3, the camera-adaptation draft of the selected Flooded Caves in Image 2. Keep the palette, restrained dark-fantasy pixel rendering, central hero and exactly three combat enemies. Image 1 is camera/scale guidance only; none of its architecture belongs in this natural cavern.

The draft FAILED in three concrete ways. Fix all three visibly:
1. It has rectangular masonry, stone-block perimeter walls, brick archways, iron prison gates and constructed dungeon alcoves. REMOVE ALL of them. Replace every perimeter and alcove with continuous irregular rounded natural bedrock, drawn as broad quiet slate-blue shapes with a few large cracks. No bricks, no block seams, no gates, no columns, no archways, no tiled floor. Wood remains only in the camp props and one small wooden bridge.
2. It has deep cliff faces, high isolated islands and tall pointed stalagmites. FLATTEN the terrain. The dry ground sits immediately beside the water, with only a thin low irregular bank, at most 10–15 image pixels of vertical face at the front edge. All dry floor is at one common elevation. Remove all freestanding pillars, all pointed stalagmites, all tiered cliffs and hanging rock walls. The lower half of the frame is a broad continuous dry gravel bank, not a row of elevated islands or pillars. The cave boundary is a short rounded rim, never a tall foreground obstruction. Show the flat top-down gameplay view from Image 1, without an isometric landscape's vertical relief.
3. The water is covered with tiny glittering ripples. SIMPLIFY it to large calm deep-teal areas with only sparse short horizontal reflections. At least 80 percent of each pool is quiet dark water without white specks or dense texture. Restrict white foam to a small patch immediately at the foot of one short waterfall. Water occupies about 25–30 percent of the image.

Recompose as three WIDE connected dry caverns: a camp on the left, central combat floor, chest on the right. A broad dry rock path across the lower middle visibly connects all three; no isolated chest islands. The central combat floor is at least six hero heights wide and four hero heights deep, with no props or rocks obscuring the actors. A single narrow river crosses behind the combat area and is crossed by a low wide timber bridge. One short waterfall enters the river through a LOW opening in the rear natural rock. Keep the river's banks flush with the floor, not deep trenches.

Preserve the player's chosen mood from Image 2: blue-grey natural stone and gravel, dark teal water, quiet moss patches, a few glowing cyan mushrooms and blue crystals at the edges, a small warm orange campfire and only a few warm torch posts. No wall-to-wall glowing decoration, no fine speckled ground texture. One red-caped hero, blue-purple spider, green goblin and skeleton on the central dry floor. Plain black unlit rock outside the caves. No HUD or text. This must read as a flat playable natural cave map, with calm surfaces, not an elevated diorama or a masonry dungeon.

BACKGROUND:
Opaque image, composed edge to edge as described in the asset prompt.

Target canvas/aspect: 1536x1024. Keep important content within safe margins.

note: Prepared only. Codex must inspect references, call built-in imagegen directly, and import the returned local image.
